purpose: Document city-local registry evidence and schema-first anonymous public geometry review.
assessment: Zambia’s government NSDI service `NSDI_Vector/CadasterNew/MapServer/0` identifies its `Lots` parcel layer as “Lots from ZILMIS”. The layer has Polygon geometry, EPSG:32735 source coordinates, public query capability and safe native `SDE.Lots.UPID` (“Plot ID”). Kitwe City Council separately lists planning/land-use services. A bounded 100 m query around the WUP point found four transport IDs and a safe-field fetch retained three full polygons with only UPID. No owner/address/account attributes or transport OIDs were retained. Official Zambia NSDI REST metadata identifies the `Lots` polygon layer and describes its source as ZILMIS. Its schema includes native UPID plot IDs, survey reference/area/date and land-use fields; no owner/address/account field is needed. Exact WUP point returned no parcel IDs; a 100 m native-coordinate buffer returned four transport IDs, and a fetch of three of them returned three complete Polygons with only UPID requested.

attempts.outcome: HTTP 200 Layer metadata: polygon geometry, native EPSG:32735, safe UPID plot ID; no owner/address fields needed.
Exact point-ID query in native EPSG:32735 returned objectIds:null. First EPSG:4326 ID request timed out; no feature attributes requested.
Four transport-only object IDs found in buffer; values not retained.

Three complete Polygon features returned, only UPID attribute requested, and retained in sample; transport OIDs omitted. Initial resultRecordCount parameter was unsupported by this service (“Pagination is not supported”).

remainingUncertainty: The point is not itself in a returned lot; whole-city coverage, legal cadastral meaning of UPID, and source completeness were not assessed.

runtimeAssessment.reason: No runtime adapter/contract test was performed.

technicalBlocker: Exact WUP point had no intersecting parcel. A nearby bounded 100 m sample did return three polygons; this is a sample only and does not qualify runtime or citywide completeness.

schemaReview.schemaNote: Layer metadata describes lots as sourced from ZILMIS. Query fetched up to three feature IDs from a 100 m native-coordinate search and returned only UPID plus geometry.
